text:
anya (CS Ops): Quick spot  about 1.1k accounts stuck on `onboard_in_progress` with no activity 45+ days. Healthscore trending down. Can we run a safe dry-run to validate auto-exit?

maria - onboarding: The auto-exit is behind the `cs.onboard_auto_exit` flag in playbook v2; we saw noise in early tests. Sampling makes sense.

anya (CS Ops): Plan: 3-step approach: 1) staging dry-run 5k sample -> tag `eligible_for_exit` only; 2) small prod shard sample 1k; 3) if safe, flip flag with ramp. Measure: healthscore delta and 14-day reactivation.

samira (CS Ops): I can run staging dry-run today and share diffs + spot-check list.

leo w: @playbook-bot schedule staging job and point results to #customer-success-reports. Also we need owner-nudge template before changing state.

playbook-bot: Scheduled `dryrun_onboard_exit_20260323_a1` on staging. Will post results to #customer-success-reports when complete.

maria - onboarding: If we apply safe-exit: set `status: stalled`, create re-engage task for owner, decrement healthscore slightly, and add a 14-day auto-reactivate window. Ensure audit log + manual restore API exists.

anya (CS Ops): Good. Samira please include CSV, histograms, and a 30-account manual spot-check. I'll draft owner-nudge copy and a rollback snippet for the runbook.

samira (CS Ops): Got it. Posting results once job finishes.

playbook-bot: Job complete. Staging sample 5k -> 3,612 eligible (72%). Median healthscore delta -0.028. Historical-sim reactivation within 14d: 4.5%. Report link: https://redwood-reports.internal/cs/dryrun/20260323-a1

anya (CS Ops): Thanks. Next: schedule 1k prod-shard sample on a weekday.

maria - onboarding: I'll ready the owner message and task payload.

leo w: tagging @eng-telemetry for a Grafana tile (`onboarding.stale_exit_rate`, `onboarding.reactivate_within_14d`).

anya (CS Ops): Action items: samira run prod sample; maria prep messaging; leo coordinate telemetry. Will update runbook at /docs/cs/onboard-stale-exit.md.
